criteria.title: Formal regression and direct handoff review
Native preservation and Responses complete handoff

observations.summary: Formal offline regressions reproduced a lost receipt on service restart and an undispatched operation running under another turn. Source recreation with SQLite now preserves ownership, exact output and at-most-once invocation; crossed turn and unknown settlement are rejected before dispatch.

Responses runtime and the Design source exchange preserve selected text, image and settlement. The restart fixture checks the exact provider output against the committed App receipt and counts one invocation after a failed submission.

Source registry and status tests cover explicit source selection. Missing stored response and stale execution claims reach explicit session errors. The native offline CLI fixture resumes its thread through the service-owned source.

The non-Design Host fixture and three canonical Design Responses cases exercise real owner validation, permission refusal, partial settlements, named reuse, selected images and mutation receipts across source recreation.

Scoped offline runtime, source, canonical exchange and native continuation checks passed. Contract, checkpoint, atomic receipt and request payload reviewed. No hosted inference or billing measurement.
